permitted_change: The response parser may accept a JSON object wrapped in a single Markdown code fence. The model input, candidate universe, proposal, prompt, schema, provider, model identifier, and decoding configuration remain unchanged.
prohibited_change: changing proposal labels before the retry
exposing retrieval, association, provenance, comparison, or report artifacts
retaining raw provider response or error text
performing another retry after this one
failure_behavior: If this retry cannot produce one complete, schema-valid output with the frozen 54-candidate set, the proposal remains unverified and no further automatic retry is allowed.
authority_boundary: A successful parser retry is still only a lifecycle review attempt. It does not itself verify a reference or permit semantic FI/FE.
